full_form: Childhood MDS with low blasts -> Refractory cytopenia with multilineage dysplasia (9985)
notes: Code 9985 — THE paediatric MDS code: SEER lists 'refractory cytopenia of childhood' and 'childhood MDS with low blasts' as explicit alternate names, and it is the commonest MDS of childhood (~50%) (Pathway 3.5). Criteria: persistent age-adjusted cytopenia, dysplasia in >=2 lineages or >=10% in one, blasts PB <2% / BM <5%, no prior cytotoxic therapy, no fibrosis; ~80% hypocellular marrow, monosomy 7 in ~20%. CD61 or CD41 IHC ON THE TREPHINE IS MANDATORY — micromegakaryocytes are what separate RCC from severe aplastic anaemia. MANDATORY before any sporadic paediatric MDS code (Pathway 3.5): (1) germline predisposition screen — GATA2, SAMD9/SAMD9L, RUNX1, ANKRD26, ETV6 (recorded as a modifier, does not change the code); (2) IBMFS exclusion — chromosome breakage/G2 arrest, telomere length, Shwachman-Diamond; (3) UGANDA ADDITION: exclude nutritional (B12/folate/iron) and HIV-related cytopenia/macrocytosis FIRST. SEER over-counting rule: code only the first MDS subtype diagnosed. No NCIt concept for cMDS-LB was recorded in the Group 1 OLS results; C8574 names MDS-MLD/RCMD, so nci_concept_id is null rather than inherited.

Code 9945. Persistent monocytosis, absolute >=0.5x10^9/L AND relative >=10% of WBC, blasts <20%. Two-tier supporting-criteria rule (Pathway 3.10): >=1x10^9/L needs >=1 supporting criterion, 0.5-<1x10^9/L needs BOTH. Exclude reactive monocytosis. CMUS/CCMUS is NOT malignant and must not be reported. In children JMML (9946) is far commoner than CMML.

Routes into tree_acute_leukemia for lineage assignment.

full_form: ALAL with BCL11B rearrangement -> MPAL, B/myeloid or T/myeloid, NOS (9808 / 9809)
notes: Pathway 5.2 uncoded-entity fallback: no ICD-O-3.2 code of its own — codes to 9808 or 9809 by the lineage combination actually demonstrated. Record BCL11B-r in genotype_annotation. Mixed phenotype acute leukaemia. Lineage assignment is intensity-relative, not binary (Pathway 2.3): myeloid needs MPO or monocytic differentiation, B needs strong CD19 plus one of CD79a/cCD22/CD10, T needs cytoplasmic or surface CD3. Routes into tree_acute_leukemia, which forks to 9808 (B/myeloid), 9809 (T/myeloid), 9806 (BCR::ABL1) or 9807 (KMT2A-r). Do not call MPAL on aberrant CD19 in t(8;21) AML (Pathway 4.3), and separate T/myeloid MPAL from ETP-ALL (9837) per Pathway 4.2.
